_comment: Copy to mcp_servers.json and fill in. Each entry becomes one MCP server connection at startup (integrations/mcp/registry_bridge.py). Tools are namespaced as '{name}_{tool}' and registered into the same ToolRegistry as every local action module, so capability_manager/execution_queue/verification all apply to them unmodified.

servers._comment: Direct local MCP server, launched as a subprocess over stdio. This is the pattern for most open-source MCP servers (github, filesystem, slack, etc) run via npx.
servers.name: github

servers._comment: Composio-hosted toolkit over streamable-HTTP. Get the per-toolkit MCP URL from the Composio dashboard after connecting the account (see integrations/mcp/composio_bridge.py for details).
servers.name: gcal

servers._comment: Generic raw HTTP MCP endpoint (self-hosted or any provider besides Composio) — same shape, no Composio-specific auth headers.
servers.name: home_assistant
